question:
While checking the determinant of $A=\begin{bmatrix}2 & -1 & 4\\0 & 3 & 5\\1 & 2 & -2\end{bmatrix}$, one student expands along the second row because it contains a zero. The student correctly obtains the minors but ignores the alternating signs of the cofactors and reports the determinant as $1$. A second student claims that the correct value must be the same whether expansion is performed along the second row or the first row. The class examines both methods to locate the error.

(a) Calculate $M_{22}$ and $M_{23}$.

(b) Determine the corresponding cofactors $A_{22}$ and $A_{23}$.

(c) Evaluate $|A|$ by expansion along the second row.

(d) Verify the result by expansion along the first row and explain the reported error.
explanation:
(a)
Deleting the second row and second column,
$$M_{22}=\begin{vmatrix}2 & 4\\1 & -2\end{vmatrix}=-4-4=-8$$
Deleting the second row and third column,
$$M_{23}=\begin{vmatrix}2 & -1\\1 & 2\end{vmatrix}=4+1=5$$

(b)
The cofactor is $A_{ij}=(-1)^{i+j}M_{ij}$. Therefore,
$$A_{22}=(-1)^4M_{22}=-8$$
$$A_{23}=(-1)^5M_{23}=-5$$

(c)
Expanding along the second row,
$$|A|=0(A_{21})+3(A_{22})+5(A_{23})$$
$$|A|=3(-8)+5(-5)=-24-25=-49$$

(d)
The cofactors of the first-row elements are
$$A_{11}=\begin{vmatrix}3 & 5\\2 & -2\end{vmatrix}=-6-10=-16$$
$$A_{12}=-\begin{vmatrix}0 & 5\\1 & -2\end{vmatrix}=5$$
$$A_{13}=\begin{vmatrix}0 & 3\\1 & 2\end{vmatrix}=-3$$
Hence,
$$|A|=2(-16)+(-1)(5)+4(-3)$$
$$|A|=-32-5-12=-49$$
The value agrees with the expansion along the second row. The incorrect value $1$ results from using the minor $M_{23}=5$ directly instead of the cofactor $A_{23}=-5$. The alternating cofactor sign was ignored.

options.A:
(a) $M_{22}=-8,\ M_{23}=5$
(b) $A_{22}=8,\ A_{23}=5$
(c) $|A|=49$
(d) First-row expansion gives $49$; the error was changing both cofactor signs
options.B:
(a) $M_{22}=-8,\ M_{23}=5$
(b) $A_{22}=-8,\ A_{23}=-5$
(c) $|A|=-49$
(d) First-row expansion also gives $-49$; the reported error came from using $M_{23}=5$ instead of $A_{23}=-5$
options.C:
(a) $M_{22}=8,\ M_{23}=-5$
(b) $A_{22}=8,\ A_{23}=5$
(c) $|A|=49$
(d) First-row expansion gives $49$; the error was caused by the zero entry
options.D:
(a) $M_{22}=-8,\ M_{23}=5$
(b) $A_{22}=-8,\ A_{23}=5$
(c) $|A|=1$
(d) First-row expansion gives $1$; no cofactor-sign error occurs
